description: Expected results for the official ROMS UPWELLING test case (myroms/roms commit bf66be4, ROMS 4.3): wind-driven upwelling/downwelling in a periodic channel, 41x80x16 grid, analytic grid/initial/forcing, 1440 steps of 300 s = 5 days. No official reference output for this case is on the server (the myroms roms_test repo is not here, and the ROMS source tree ships none), so the values were recorded from real runs of the server UPWELLING binary. Repeat runs give bit-identical NetCDF output and identical stdout energy tables.
engine_version: ROMS 4.3, git bf66be420a4df245b93aa4f64086a5c89ac71e1f, serial romsS built with ROMS_APP=UPWELLING (gfortran -O3 -ffast-math)
finished_normally_check: return code 0, 'ROMS: DONE' in the log, log 'Header file' = upwelling.h, KI tool log scan finds no errors, roms_his.nc created

numeric_checks.name: n_diag_rows
numeric_checks.why: one energy/volume row per step, steps 0..1440 (NTIMES=1440, NINFO=1)

numeric_checks.name: his_records
numeric_checks.why: ROMS's own count of history records (NHIS=72 -> every 6 h for 5 days, plus t=0)

numeric_checks.name: his_ocean_time_end_s
numeric_checks.why: last history time = 1440 steps x 300 s = 5 days

numeric_checks.name: final_kinetic_energy
numeric_checks.why: domain kinetic energy at step 1440 from ROMS stdout table

numeric_checks.name: final_potential_energy
numeric_checks.why: domain potential energy at step 1440 from ROMS stdout table

numeric_checks.name: final_total_energy
numeric_checks.why: domain total energy at step 1440 from ROMS stdout table

numeric_checks.name: initial_total_energy
numeric_checks.why: total energy at step 0 (analytic initial state)

numeric_checks.name: final_net_volume
numeric_checks.why: domain water volume (m3) at step 1440; tol = print precision

numeric_checks.name: net_volume_rel_change
numeric_checks.why: volume conservation: relative change step 0 -> 1440 in the closed periodic channel

numeric_checks.name: final_max_speed
numeric_checks.why: max current speed (m/s) at step 1440 from ROMS stdout table

numeric_checks.name: his_final_temp_min
numeric_checks.why: min temperature (C) in the last history record

numeric_checks.name: his_final_temp_max
numeric_checks.why: max temperature (C) in the last history record

numeric_checks.name: his_final_temp_mean
numeric_checks.why: mean temperature (C, plain grid-point mean) in the last history record

numeric_checks.name: his_final_zeta_max
numeric_checks.why: max sea-surface height (m) in the last history record (wind set-up)

numeric_checks.name: his_final_u_min
numeric_checks.why: strongest along-channel current u (m/s) in the last history record

notes: Tolerances are set near the print precision of the stdout table and well above float32 rounding of the history file, so a rebuild with another compiler should still pass; they are not official ROMS tolerances. The ROMS source checkout has 3 local edits (link flags, a LEKIMA-only block in ana_vmix.h, a guard in inp_par.F); none is active in the UPWELLING path.
